scenes.title: Settings, team, security and privacy
scenes.subtitle: Your agency, set up your way and kept safe
scenes.narration: Set the agency up once, bring your team in with the right access, and keep accounts and customer data safe.
All settings live in one place, grouped so you can find them: company, team, communication, finance, security and data.
Your company profile and logo appear on every quote, invoice and voucher you send.
Everyone has their own profile and can change their password. Passwords need at least twelve characters, with a letter and a digit.
Invite a teammate with one of six roles. They get an email with a link to set their own password, and the link works once.
This is the invitation as it arrives.
Turn on two-factor sign-in: scan the code with an authenticator app, type the six digits it shows, and keep the recovery codes somewhere safe.
Admins can require two-factor for the whole agency, and everyone can see their active sessions and sign-in history, and sign out a device they do not recognise.
The activity log records who changed what, and when.
Each person picks which notifications they get, and sets quiet hours.
When a customer asks what you hold about them, export it in one file. If they ask to be forgotten, erase their personal details; the bookings stay for your accounts.
Use TravelCRM Pro as a Windows app or in the browser. The download and quick-start pages get a new teammate going in minutes.
Sign in with email and password, or with a one-time code by text message where SMS is set up. Forgot the password? A reset link comes by email.

scenes.headline: Set up once. Safe every day.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Set up once, and safe every day.
